similar_scenes.name: College-pop y nacimiento del lo-fi
similar_scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
similar_scenes.desc: La población universitaria del Sur adopta la ética de la new wave y la adapta a la melodía: un pop inusualmente intelectual, con raíces en el folk-rock y el country-rock pero contaminado por las neurosis de la época. Athens (Georgia) compite con las capitales del rock: B-52's y R.E.M., uno de los grupos de más éxito de la historia. Carolina del Norte (dB's, Windbreakers), Hoboken (Smithereens, Bongos, Tiny Lights), el nacimiento del lo-fi (Half Japanese, Violent Femmes, Beat Happening, Guided By Voices, Sebadoh), They Might Be Giants, Green, B.A.L.L., Boston (Volcano Suns, 10,000 Maniacs, Throwing Muses, Blake Babies), la Costa Oeste (Game Theory, Posies, Young Fresh Fellows) y la sátira de Ween.

similar_scenes.name: Lo-fi pop
similar_scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
similar_scenes.desc: El gran invento de los independientes neozelandeses se convierte en uno de los fenómenos mundiales de los noventa: Cakekitchen, Bailter Space, Underground Lovers, King Loser; en Australia, Blackeyed Susans y Moles. En EE UU, Olympia (Beat Happening, Some Velvet Sidewalk, Spinanes), Modest Mouse y, sobre todo, Pavement, el grupo lo-fi más influyente (Slanted And Enchanted), con su contagio por todo el país (Silver Jews, Crowsdell). La vertiente más creativa, heredera de Half Japanese y los Residents: Trumans Water, Velocity Girl, Heavy Vegetable, Quintron, Danielson Famile, Soul Junk.

similar_scenes.name: Cantautores lo-fi de los noventa
similar_scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
similar_scenes.desc: Los noventa son la década del cantautor: la tecnología y las redes informales del post-punk favorecen la carrera en solitario, con Joni Mitchell y Leonard Cohen (no Dylan ni Springsteen) como maestros. El folk sombrío inaugurado por Chris Isaak, Smog y American Music Club se convierte casi en un género: Vic Chesnutt, Mark Lanegan, Mountain Goats, Elliott Smith, Jeff Buckley, Ron Sexsmith, Mike Johnson, Simon Joyner, Songs:Ohia. El neo-pop de Stephen Merritt (Magnetic Fields: Holiday, The Charm Of The Highway Strip, 69 Love Songs), Chris Connelly, Frank Black, Mike Gira (Body Lovers, Angels Of Light), Richard Davies y Eric Matthews (Cardinal), David Gray. El neo-folk de Beck (folk para la era del hip hop), John Frusciante, Sparklehorse, Bright Eyes, Rufus Wainwright, Grandaddy, Bobby Conn; el neo-country de Richard Buckner y Freedy Johnston; Steve Wynn, Mike Watt, Paul Westerberg, Ben Harper.

podcast.title: 1990s Influence on Bedroom Pop
podcast.body: The lo-fi sounds and attitude prevalent in the 1990s are identified as having a definite connection to Bedroom Pop, suggesting a stylistic lineage. "And there's a definite connection to both Dreampop, which was a product of the 80s, and the low-fi slacker sounds in attitude of the 1990s."

podcast.title: Genre of Mercury Prize Winners
podcast.body: Young Fathers, an Edinburgh-based band, are described as a "fantastic Lo-fi Indy Tronica band" and won Britain's Mercury Prize in 2014. "Young fathers, fantastic Lofi Indy Tronica band from Edinburgh, who won Britain's Mercury Prize in 2014."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Part of Alt Rock Umbrella
podcast.body: Lo-fi was one of the "new fresh, strange and fascinating sounds" discovered under the umbrella of Alternative Rock in the 1990s. "Things like Goth, Industrial, Shoegays, Lofi, even singer songwriters that didn't fit the mainstream's view of Rock."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Studying Aid Classification
podcast.body: Lo-fi tracks were listed as a "best study buddy genre," being only slightly less effective than pop music for studying. "It's only slightly better than low-fi tracks."

podcast.title: YouTube Algorithm and Viral Popularity
podcast.body: Lo-Fi is mentioned as a musical movement that, similar to soundfont albums, sometimes accidentally gained viral popularity through the YouTube algorithm. This occurred without the backing of traditional industry promotion or extensive marketing campaigns. "A veces, por accidente, el vapor Wai-Fa ya no el terreno, y permitió que movimientos como Low-Fight, el eslaüe Tan-River o los soundfont albums, se volvieran virales."
